question: Of the customers who signed up in 2024, how many had no completed order during 2024? Break the count down by region.

sql_attempts.sql: SELECT r.region_name, COUNT(c.customer_id) AS customer_count FROM customers AS c JOIN regions AS r ON c.region_id = r.region_id WHERE c.signup_date >= '2024-01-01' AND c.signup_date <= '2024-12-31' AND NOT c.customer_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT o.customer_id FROM orders AS o WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date <= '2024-12-31') GROUP BY r.region_name LIMIT 500

answer: Of the customers who signed up in 2024 and had no completed orders during that year, the breakdown by region is as follows: North America has 50 customers, EMEA has 36 customers, APAC has 32 customers, and LATAM has 18 customers.
